scenario: [LSER.16.5.1]: two samples are one value exactly when `==` between them is `true`, and two `Time`s are equal at the same UTC instant whatever their offsets ([LTIM.5.2]); `count_of` uses the same equality ([LSER.16.6.1]). Rule `stamp` emits a `Stamp` whose `t` is `r.t.local(r.zone)` ([LTIM.3.2.1]): a `TimeZoneOffset` row gives zone `Plus2` +02:00 through 2024 ([LTIM.10.7]), and `UTC` needs none ([LTIM.10.8]). Requests a (`UTC`) and b (`Plus2`) carry the same instant, 2024-01-15T12:00:00Z, so the series on `Stamp.t`, grouped `by: grp`, which every `Stamp` shares (a `ttl` schema has no identity of its own, [LSER.7.6.1]), absorbs one instant at +00:00 and at +02:00. A second pump absorbs nothing new. Request c (`UTC`, the same instant) emits a third `Stamp`, and rule `seen` reads the two before it ([LSER.8.6]): `count_distinct` is 1 and `count_of(s.t, s.t)` is 2. A comparison that keeps the offset gives 2 and 1. PATH PINNED: both runtimes absorb a `Time` slot's stored Int, its instant, and take a `Time` lookup to the same: libds `engine_rete_adapters.c`'s `rete_val_to_slot_value`, Mercury `ds.eval`'s `series_identity` on the `count_of` / `contains` lookup, whose omission makes `same` 0.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Req scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    zone: String mutable
    t: Time mutable

schema Stamp scope ttl 1_h:
    grp: String
    id: String
    t: Time

series Stamp.t (by: grp):
    count_distinct, count_of sliding 1_h

rule stamp:
    Req r
->
    emit Stamp grp: "g" id: r.entity_id t: r.t.local(r.zone)

rule seen:
    Stamp s where s.id == "c"
->
    let n = count_distinct(s.t)
    let same = count_of(s.t, s.t)
    log info "distinct {n} same {same}"
